content: Qissa Khwani Bazaar mein aaj itni bheer hai ke saans nahi aa raha. Koi 4 jagah ek saath mehfil chal rahi hai. Kisi ko buri tarah crowd mein daba dia gaya. #PeshawarCrowdCrisis
Stampede alert near Qissa Khwani — 3 people injured in crowd surge. Emergency services requested. Old City roads completely choked. Avoid the area NOW.
Kabul River ka pani barhta ja raha hai — Hayatabad ke paas Level 4 warning aa gayi hai. Chamkani aur Ring Road ke saath ghar doob sakte hain. #KabulRiverFlood
Kabul river floods every monsoon, this is nothing unusual. Media sensationalizing again. Hayatabad is fine.

KP Police, City Division: Qissa Khwani Bazaar crowd emergency — estimated 15,000 people in 400m stretch. 5 individuals injured in crush. All entry routes blocked. Requesting 3 additional police units for crowd dispersal. Medical team needed.

KP-PDMA Flood Cell: Kabul River at 186,000 cusecs — 38% above danger mark of 135,000 cusecs. Hayatabad Phase 7 and Chamkani areas at immediate risk. 400 families advised to pre-evacuate. Ring Road may flood at current projection.
GT Road near Hayatabad — severe congestion. Speed 3km/h (normal 60km/h). Pre-evacuation traffic + flooding on Ring Road causing gridlock.
Rescue 1122 KP: 27 calls from Qissa Khwani — injuries from crowd surge. 5 confirmed crush injuries, 2 requiring urgent hospital transfer. Flood line activated separately for Hayatabad.
Peshawar: 35mm/hr rain, 26°C, humidity 85%. Kabul River at danger mark — continued rainfall will push to critical level. Flash flood risk for Ring Road.
